data.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend the defense record schema (review-defenses.md contract) with an optional github_comment_id field. PR-anchored defenses populate it; non-PR-anchored defenses leave it absent. Update both TrackerDefenseStore and GitHubPRDefenseStore to write the field when GitHub context is available.

**Why**: Auto-resolve (d5) needs the GitHub comment ID to call resolveReviewThread. Without this contract change, auto-resolve has nothing to anchor on. Absent-means-skip is the safe fallback for defenses captured outside a PR context.

**Scope**:
- IN: review-defenses.md contract update; TrackerDefenseStore + GitHubPRDefenseStore writers; backward-compat: absent field means skip auto-resolve (logged as INFO, not error)
- OUT: Auto-resolve consumption (covered by d5); contract for the b575 arbiter (coordinated separately — d4 only declares the field; b575 declares its meaning for arbiter rulings)

## Done Definitions
- When this story is complete, Contract documents optional field with absent-means-skip semantic
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "When the arbiter (Epic `b575-ac1c-f720-4839`) rules a finding DROP / DEFER / accepts a defense, AND the defense record contains a `github_comment_id`,")
- When this story is complete, PR-anchored defense populates field; non-PR-anchored leaves absent/null
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "When the arbiter (Epic `b575-ac1c-f720-4839`) rules a finding DROP / DEFER / accepts a defense, AND the defense record contains a `github_comment_id`,")
- When this story is complete, Legacy record reads succeed with field absent
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "When the arbiter (Epic `b575-ac1c-f720-4839`) rules a finding DROP / DEFER / accepts a defense, AND the defense record contains a `github_comment_id`,")

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Absent github_comment_id must be logged as INFO not WARN/ERROR — non-PR contexts are legitimate
- [Cross-epic] Coordinate field semantics with b575-ac1c-f720-4839 (cycle-end arbiter)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a defense-store contract owner, I can record an optional github_comment_id on every defense record so the auto-resolve flow can locate the originating GitHub thread
